g.text: Build a horizontal arm that matches the model
100 mm axis-to-axis links • Two parallel vertical motor axes • A lightweight pointer, no payload
Use matched horns and bearing-supported brackets.
Keep support bearings coaxial with the output shafts.
Final bracket dimensions depend on your actual parts.
Engineering layout, not a fabrication drawing or a photograph of a built arm. Top-view joint coordinates use the original RobotArm2DOF.
